capabilities: open a chosen note in every new tab
trigger the Quick Switcher when a new tab opens
choose the mode the default page opens in
display dynamic content such as a random quote via a dataviewjs block
extras: Author states the plugin is in maintenance mode: no new features (including support for other plugins) will be added, but it remains available. Closing the last tab also opens the new tab page.
problem: Obsidian opens new tabs empty, with no built-in way to set a default page such as a homepage, daily note, or scratchpad.

relations.evidence: To have a random quote on every new tab, you can use dataview

summary: New-tab page plugin that opens a note of your choice, or the Quick Switcher, whenever a new tab is created, like in a browser.
